body: Refusal of martyrdom: raw, boundaryless instinct that will not dissolve itself to keep others comfortable. Deep sensitivity and empathy attuned to the unseen, carrying a real loneliness. The fear of being judged can lead you to over-conform, 'act normal,' and over-work until you can't, quietly imprisoning the real self. The way back is letting the sensitivity and inner life be real and expressed rather than hidden.
business: Owned, this is compassion with a spine.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes victimhood and escape; unchecked, chaos and lost boundaries.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
